common.tagline: Ukwemera muri buri nota. Ubuhanga muri buri ijwi.

home.intro: Korali gatolika iririmba muri liturujiya n'indirimbo zisingiza Imana, muri Paruwasi Regina Pacis, Remera, i Kigali, kuva mu 2006.
home.photoAlt: Abaririmbyi ba Chorale Christus Regnat bambaye imyenda yera ifite amabara ya zahabu

practice.title: Aho wadusanga
practice.rehearsalsDays: Buri wa Kabiri no ku wa Gatanu
practice.rehearsalsNote: Wifuza kuririmbana natwe? Menya uko winjira muri korali.
practice.massText: Turirimba mu Misa yo ku Cyumweru hakurikijwe gahunda ya buri kwezi: muri Paruwasi Regina Pacis, muri Centre Christus no muri Paruwasi Katedrali ya Mutagatifu Mikayile, rimwe na rimwe no mu Misa ya mu gitondo cya kare.

committee.title: Menya komite yacu
committee.subtitle: Komite nyobozi ikorera korali
committee.sampleNote: Amazina y'agateganyo kugeza komite nyayo yongewemo.

comingSoon.text: Iyi paji iracyategurwa. Mwihangane, mugaruke mu kanya.

join.title: Ngwino turirimbane
join.intro: Ukunda kuririmba no gukorera Imana binyuze mu ndirimbo? Chorale Christus Regnat yakira abanyamuryango bashya bifuza gusingiza Imana mu ndirimbo za liturujiya n'iza gospel.

steps.title: Ngwino mu myitozo
steps.text: Udusure ku wa Kabiri cyangwa ku wa Gatanu nimugoroba kuri Ste Famille (JOC), utubwire ko wifuza kwinjira muri korali.

steps.title: Hitamo ijwi ryawe
steps.text: Abenshi binjira muri korali basanzwe baririmba, bityo utangirira mu ijwi usanzwe uzi: soprano, alto, tenor cyangwa bass. Witoza nk'umunyamuryango mushya, korali igakurikirana uko witabira.

steps.title: Isuzuma
steps.text: Itsinda rya tekiniki rirakusuzuma, kandi rishobora kukwimurira mu rindi jwi rikubereye. Niba utaritegura bihagije, ukomeza kwitoza ugasuzumwa nanone nyuma y'igihe.

steps.title: Ba umunyamuryango wuzuye
steps.text: Numara gutsinda isuzuma, uba umunyamuryango wuzuye: witabira Inteko Rusange kandi ugatanga umusanzu wa buri kwezi.

join.applyNote: Vuba aha uzabasha kuzuza ifishi yo kwinjira kuri internet. Kugeza ubu, ngwino uduhure mu myitozo.
